ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Reconnaissance For Cached Credentials Via Cmdkey.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of cmdkey to look for cached credentials on the system

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmdkey\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "cmdkey\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-l.*"))
